derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.64 dense route-field localization failed at 0.11787 and after r7.78a independently reproduced a safe-lateral false open. This probe tests whether directly supervising six future waypoint coordinates avoids diffuse heatmap readout failure. No result-driven feature, alpha, target, split, or event threshold search is permitted.

input.additional_features: one global standard deviation per input channel

target.coordinate_per_horizon: center of the argmax patch in each frozen r7.64 Gaussian teacher field

probe.standardization: training-fold weighted mean and standard deviation only
probe.sample_weighting: equal total mass per training source, weights sum to training row count

event_readout.point_per_horizon: predicted continuous waypoint mapped to its containing 16x16 patch
event_readout.event_score: mean fraction of three predicted horizon points inside frozen expanded marker mask

gate.strict_event_label_separation: minimum positive event score must exceed maximum negative event score
